requirements.text: Create docs/DISCOVERY_BACKLOG.md - a NOT-auto-injected ledger of mid-work product/domain discoveries. Each entry carries: stable id (DB-nnn), date, the discovery, its source (task/report/probe), the pipeline implication, and a lifecycle status from exactly {OPEN, QUEUED(<task-id>), RESOLVED(<task-id or record>), WATCH(<review trigger>)}. Boundary: the backlog holds discoveries NOT already tracked as ledger tasks, blockers, or directive requirements - it never duplicates those systems, it feeds them.
requirements.required_harness: File exists with the entry schema; seeded from the currently-scattered findings at creation.

requirements.text: Record-at-discovery duty: when mid-work evidence surfaces a product/domain discovery with a pipeline implication (a data-model gap, a newly observed real-world case class, an advisory review finding routed to follow-up, an external-source condition), append a backlog entry in the same working session it was found - never defer to session end.
requirements.required_harness: Backlog grows at discovery time (commit timestamps near the discovery evidence).

requirements.text: Sweep-at-planning duty: at every contract seam and every replan, the orchestrator sweeps the backlog's OPEN and WATCH entries and moves each touched entry forward - queue it as a ledger task (QUEUED), resolve it with the closing record (RESOLVED), or re-affirm WATCH with its trigger. No entry is ever silently dropped; deletion is prohibited (entries only change status).
requirements.required_harness: Contract/replan commits show backlog status transitions; handoffs reference the sweep.
